title: StickObservation
description: Per-frame, per-hand stick axis and tip estimate (Phase 01 contract; produced by a TipEstimator in stick, Phase 03). docs/architecture/contracts.md section 3.3.

present.description: False when no stick estimate exists for this hand in this frame (hand absent or estimator failed); geometry fields are then null and confidences are 0.

axis_origin.description: Point on the stick axis near the hand (e.g. grip centre), ROI-normalized.

axis_dir.description: Unit direction from axis_origin towards the tip.

tip.description: Estimated stick tip, ROI-normalized. May lie outside [0,1]^2.

tip_confidence.description: Producer-defined confidence in the tip estimate; consumed by tracking against c_valid / c_min.

stick_length_est.description: Apparent stick length in ROI-normalized units, if estimated; null otherwise.
